ModMetaData.name: Schadenfreude
ModMetaData.author: T&B Modding
ModMetaData.description: Colonists can privately enjoy a disliked colonist's witnessed setback. Affection, solidarity and severity complicate the reaction. Currently observes insults and mood breakdowns only. No DLC required. Focused in-game scenarios tested with the Psyche collection; broader compatibility remains unverified.
